title: A MISS TURNS A RUNNING PILLAGER TOO
why: His note of 2026-10-12: a running pillager bot should turn hostile when fired on. v23.59 turned a pillager running for a ring on the round that hits him. A round that only goes past him is still being fired on, and he kept running through a whole magazine of misses. A round that passes close to him now turns him the same way: hostile, coming for you and firing back, and he stays in the fight. Your hires and pillagers who joined you are unchanged.
now: A fleeing pillager you shoot at now turns and fights back even when you miss.
